entry.title: Pentagon needs $50B for mass drone production, Hegseth says
entry.summary: The budget request does not establish that the reconciliation funding Hegseth cited is the same money or that it is dedicated entirely to drone purchases Hegseth characterized the funding as a one-time investment rather than a recurring annual allocation, intended to accelerate the development and production of autonomous and robotic systems. “Ultimately we will be dealing with hundreds of thousands of one-way attack systems this year and into the millions in years to come at a pace that this department’s never ever seen before.” The Defense Secretary said the Pentagon must make it easier for new companies to compete in a defense market long dominated by established contractors and costly platforms. Traditional defense firms remain important, he said, but the department also needs lower-cost systems that can be manufactured at scale.

entry.title: Ukraine races to field faster interceptors as Russia hammers its energy grid
entry.summary: KYIV, Ukraine — Russia is still using fast jet-powered drones to batter Ukraine’s energy facilities, bridges and other critical infrastructure at speeds beyond the reach of most of Kyiv’s drone interceptors, despite U.S. President Donald Trump’s unilateral announcement on Sunday of an energy ceasefire between the two countries. Russia began using the jets heavily in July, when their numbers jumped fivefold from the previous month. 关键事实：Ukraine — Russia is still using fast jet-powered drones to batter Ukraine’s energy facilities；other critical infrastructure at speeds beyond the reach of most of Kyiv’s drone interceptors；President Donald Trump’s unilateral announcement on Sunday of an energy ceasefire between the two countries

entry.title: Hegseth, service secretaries discuss ‘generational change’ of Autonomous Warfare Command
entry.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s vision for the planned Autonomous Warfare Command over the next two years “is that we're still iterating, we're still adapting, we're still learning, and we're moving faster and faster because we're doing it. We understand how to do it better with each iteration.” Hegseth sat down to discuss the Defense Department’s efforts to advance its autonomous capabilities with the service secretaries and the Pentagon’s top civilian for special operations during a panel Wednesday at AUSA’s annual meeting in Washington, D.C., but the discussion offered few details on what the forthcoming AUTOWARCOM, scheduled to activate by Oct. 1, 2027, will look like and how it will accomplish its mission. The secretary, who has ordered cuts to and flag officer positions across the military services, was asked why a four-star combatant command is the correct vehicle to speed up acquisition and fielding of autonomous systems. “Let's put rank where we need it to ensure we can drive change quickly,” Hegseth said. “We're going to use rank to drive change with the right people in those positions, but not just legacy formations and commands which have gathered over time and haven't led to battlefield efforts.” He did not say whether a search is on for commander candidates and what kind of experience he’s looking for. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth\u2019s vision for the planned Autonomous Warfare Command over the next two years \u201cis that we're still iterating, we're still adapting, we're still learning, and we're moving faster and faster because we're doing it.

entry.title: F-35C Makes First Arrested Landing Aboard A Ford Class Carrier
entry.summary: A U.S. Navy F-35C has made the first arrested landing for the type aboard a Ford class aircraft carrier, with the milestone taking place aboard the future USS John F. The milestone marks a major step in testing the Navy’s stealth fighter aboard its newest carrier class, following years of challenges integrating advanced launch and recovery systems. Two F-35C test pilots assigned to Air Test and Evaluation Squadron 23 (VX-23), part of the Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division (NAWCAD), flew to the carrier as part of an ongoing Aircraft Compatibility Testing (ACT) campaign. 关键事实：Navy F-35C has made the first arrested landing for the type aboard a Ford class aircraft carrier；with the milestone taking place aboard the future USS John F；The milestone marks a major step in testing the Navy’s stealth fighter aboard its newest carrier class

entry.title: Ukrainian military’s access to Starlink satellite internet suddenly restricted
entry.summary: Ukraine’s military has suddenly had its access to Starlink satellite internet terminals restricted as the Trump administration has increased pressure on Ukraine to halt long-range strikes on Russia’s oil industry immediately. The terminals, which are produced by Elon Musk’s SpaceX but managed by the US government, are a key component of Ukraine’s military operations and the sudden restrictions on the terminals travelling at high speeds on Tuesday evening led to the failure of several combat missions, said an adviser on military technology to Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy. The sudden outage came as Russia launched ballistic missiles at Ukraine without any advance warning from the US for a second night. For years, the US has provided Ukraine with intelligence when strikes were about to take place. Donald Trump has denied that his administration has cut intelligence sharing with Ukraine. Zelenskyy also indicated that the US was continuing to share intelligence with Ukraine in an interview with NPR aired on Wednesday, but confirmed that military advisers had received threats from the US that intelligence sharing could be limited. Ukraine did not receive any warning before Russia launched its first barrage of ballistic missiles on Tuesday evening, according to Col Yurii Ihnat, a spokesperson for the air force. But it did receive warnings from “foreign partners” about three subsequent barrages, leaving further confusion about whether or not the US is intentionally withholding intelligence from Ukraine. 关键事实：The terminals；which are produced by Elon Musk’s SpaceX

entry.title: SAXON Q Reports That Room-Temperature Quantum Computers Can Rival the Performance of Superconducting Processors
entry.summary: Insider Brief SAXON Q reported that its room-temperature diamond quantum computer achieved 77.3% success in a three-qubit Grover search, close to the cited superconducting benchmark of 78%. The system achieved 87% success when searching for two targets among eight items, with both tests exceeding the classical success limits cited in the paper. Researchers conducted the benchmark at Fraunhofer IWU in Dresden using a previous-generation system that consumes roughly 600 watts and requires no cryogenic cooling or vacuum equipment. 关键事实：Insider Brief SAXON Q reported that its room-temperature diamond quantum computer achieved 77.3% success in a three-qubit Grover search；close to the cited superconducting benchmark of 78%；The system achieved 87% success when searching for two targets among eight items

entry.title: L3Harris delivers first VAMPIRE counter-drone systems to US Army
entry.summary: L3Harris Technologies has begun delivering its VAMPIRE counter-unmanned aircraft systems (C-UAS) to the US Army, with the first units arriving within two months of a USD106 million order announced in June. VAMPIRE is a self-contained weapons system designed to provide reconnaissance and precision-strike capabilities against drones and other remotely piloted aircraft. The system is intended to help military forces defend personnel and critical assets against hostile unmanned aerial threats. L3Harris said VAMPIRE technology has been used extensively in European combat operations, accumulating more than 350,000 operational hours since 2023. The deliveries follow the establishment of a dedicated VAMPIRE production facility in Huntsville, Alabama, earlier this year. The facility was set up to support increased production in response to growing demand for counter-unmanned systems in the US and international markets. 关键事实：L3Harris Technologies has begun delivering its VAMPIRE counter-unmanned aircraft systems (C-UAS) to the US Army；with the first units arriving within two months of a USD106 million order announced in June；VAMPIRE is a self-contained weapons system designed to provide reconnaissance

entry.title: Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out
entry.summary: In a new paper in Nature , the researchers describe their approach and show how it enables forecasts that for the first time beat climatologic averages between two and six weeks. “Not only does this do better on time averaged forecasts for this range, which is already very useful for farmers and members of the energy industry trying to match supply with demand, but it also improves predictions of extreme weather events, whether it’s flooding or cold spells or something else,” co-author and MIT Research Scientist Judah Cohen says. 关键事实：In a new paper in Nature；the researchers describe their approach；show how it enables forecasts that for the first time beat climatologic averages between two
